title: Provenance Data Eligibility Report (PHEME + RumourEval / SemEval-2017 Task 8)
decision: All provenance case types P1-P5 supported on real data at A/B grade; MSM-style provenance unsupported and reported as such.

rules.rule: Message-level claim values that are human ground truth
rules.evidence: RumourEval subtask-A stance labels (support/deny -> claim value) are human-annotated; 960 support + 358 deny occur in PHEME.

rules.rule: Explicit reply genealogy recoverable from stored files
rules.evidence: structure.json per thread; reconstruction audit recomputes 95,073 parent edges with 100% agreement vs in_reply_to_status_id_str (0 mismatches).
Tweet created_at (RFC-2822) parsed for all 105,354 tweets; drives frozen R (7-day half-life).

rules.rule: Multiple events spanning a meaningful window
Veracity gold independent of resolver inputs
rules.evidence: Journalist true/misinformation never an input to R, C or T; per-case gold coherence = 1.0.
Independence defined by distinct thread origins (category index only); L1 classifier consumes explicit lineage only.
1,045 case units (manifest 02); global asserting pool 1,318 labels (960+358).
14 selected cases, each >= 2 distinct roots (2-7 origins); 35 candidate categories globally; composition B.
20 selected cases with explicit ancestor-descendant labelled pairs; 112 candidate threads globally.
20 selected cases with >= 2 distinct structure branches under one root; 260 candidate threads globally.
P2 intra-thread support and deny chains (20); P4 cross-thread support x deny (20); P5 mixed (6).
50,593 unique users; case units span many distinct user_id values.

rules.rule: Frozen labels, no tuning on TEST / no calibration
rules.evidence: All labels are stock QCRI train/dev/test files; Psi, C, T, theta, R half-life frozen; no grid search, no retraining.
Artifact 09 records SHA-256 of archives, labels, frozen protocol, tools, outputs, download provenance and environment.

decision_table.item: P1 same category, >=2 independent root threads, no shared lineage, converging claim value
P2 reply-tree parent -> child propagation chain (incl. intra-thread conflict)
P3 shared root with >=2 distinct branches
P4 support in one root thread vs deny in another root thread (cross-thread conflict)
P5 mixed provenance (P1/P4/P2 within one category)

integrity: 3,270 of 5,026 joined labels are comment/query (non-asserting); they never become case units.
64 labelled asserting tweets skipped (thread lacked category/true); documented as skipped_no_truth.
Case units are disjoint across all 80 cases (0 duplicates).
annotation.links[*].position is per-link and was not used as a message-level stance; values come exclusively from RumourEval subtask-A labels.
